facts.fact: Central Government pensioners aged 80 and above can submit the life certificate from 1 October each year (DoPPW order of 18.07.2019)
facts.quote: This step is in addition to the order issued recently dated 18.07.2019 vide which all pensioners age 80 years and above have been given an exclusive window to submit their Life Certificate w.e.f. 1st October every year instead of 1st November every year.

facts.fact: The window closes on 30 November, so for 2026 it is 1 October to 30 November 2026 for a pensioner aged 80+
facts.quote: has issued directions to all the Pension Disbursing Banks to send SMSs/Emails to all their pensioners on 24th October, 1st November, 15th November and 25th November every year reminding them to submit their Annual Life Certificates by 30th November.
facts.note: The 2026 dates are derived from this standing annual rule (and the 1 October rule above); no DoPPW OM giving the 2026 Campaign 5.0 dates was found on pib.gov.in or doppw.gov.in on 28 Oct 2026.

facts.fact: A Digital Life Certificate can be generated at home with Aadhaar face authentication, which needs only a smartphone
facts.quote: The Government of India has launched the Face Authentication Technique which requires only a smartphone for generation of DLCs.

facts.fact: IPPB provides the DLC at the doorstep: contact the nearest post office or request a doorstep visit by the postman/Gramin Dak Sevak
facts.quote: To avail DLC service, a customer can contact the nearest post office or place a request for a doorstep visit by the postman/Grameen Dak Sevak.

facts.fact: IPPB charges Rs 70 (inclusive of GST/cess) per successful DLC
facts.quote: For every successful generation of DLC, a nominal fee of Rs. 70 (inclusive of GST/ CESS) will be charged.

facts.fact: There is no separate doorstep charge for the IPPB DLC
facts.quote: There will be no doorstep charges levied for IPPB or non-IPPB customers for issuance of DLC.

facts.fact: Pension disbursing banks draw up an exception list as on 1 December of pensioners who have not submitted the life certificate and send them another reminder
facts.quote: directed all Pension Disbursing Banks to make an exception list as on 1st December every year of those pensioners who fail to submit their Life Certificate and issue another SMS/Email to them for submitting the Life Certificate.

summary: All turn facts confirmed: 80+ window from 1 Oct to 30 Nov (2026 dates derived from the standing rule), face auth from home, IPPB doorstep DLC at Rs 70 with no doorstep charge, exception list on 1 December.
